correctness.rationale: For every pair g,h the rank of gh−I gives exactly a zero-only, one-dimensional rank-one or full matrix domain. Cyclic trace proves necessity; explicit idempotent and nilpotent sandwiches give surjectivity onto every allowed line map; composition of line maps is again a line map or zero-only; full maps are exactly PGL₂(k) conjugations. Counts are e²+n²(q−1)+|PGL₂(q)|+1 with e=q(q+1), n=q+1. Independent finite q=2,3 computation corroborates, not proves, the theorem.
